# Roof racks and storage nets

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Install footman loops by drilling through two layers of metal and securing screws at around 7 torque. [t999]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Install footman loops on the cargo area floor to reinforce attachment points.
2. Drill holes through two layers of metal (plastic liner then sheet metal) for each loop, being gentle not to strip the hole.
3. Secure the screws in the footman loops by hand or with a drill set to an adjustable torque setting around 7.

_Procedure reported by [t999]._

## Tools

- Drill [t999]
- Metal drill bits [t999]

## Parts

- [Partial] Footman Loops & Screws [t999]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a very small flat head screwdriver to remove the factory D-ring if necessary, as it may not be strong enough for heavy loads. [t999]
- [Partial] If removing the D-ring, cover the hole with a push plug similar to those used on grilles. [t999]
